title: A report download joins the query name into a file path

pr.title: Add downloads for monthly reports and yearly report archives
pr.description: Two new routes let a signed-in user download one monthly report by its file name, or the archive of one year. REPORT_ROOT sets the report folder.

bugs.note: The name comes from the query string of the client (routes.ts, avatars.ts). join() keeps '..', so name=../../../etc/passwd or ../../app/.env reads any file that the server process can read. avatars.ts and downloadArchive use resolveInside(), which refuses a path outside the root. Use resolveInside(REPORT_ROOT, `monthly/${name}`).

traps.why: REPORT_ROOT comes from an environment variable that the operator sets at deploy time, as the comment says. Operator config is trusted, so a path traversal or injection finding on it is wrong.
The year goes through resolveInside(), which returns null for a path outside REPORT_ROOT, so send() answers 404. A path traversal finding here is wrong.
